26:             $times = $doc.SelectSingleNode('//t:Times', $nsm)
27:             "TRX $($trx.FullName.Substring($runRoot.Length)) written=$($trx.LastWriteTime.ToString('s')) start=$($times.GetAttribute('start')) total=$($c.GetAttribute('total')) executed=$($c.GetAttribute('executed')) passed=$($c.GetAttribute('passed')) failed=$($c.GetAttribute('failed')) notExecuted=$($c.GetAttribute('notExecuted'))"

31:                 if ($msg.Length -gt 400) { $msg = $msg.Substring(0, 400) }
32:                 "  $($r.GetAttribute('outcome')) $($r.GetAttribute('testName')) :: $msg"
33:             }
34:         }
35:         catch { "TRX $($trx.FullName) unreadable: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
36:     }
37: }
